clips.label: Start adventure
clips.text: Welcome to the table. You will make the choices; the dice and the world will answer them.

clips.label: Open Brindlehook Inn
clips.text: The Brindlehook Inn is warm, noisy, and full of people who have stopped watching the door.

clips.label: Open Crypt of Whispers
clips.text: The crypt answers footsteps with an echo that seems to arrive a moment too late.

clips.label: Open Smugglers Cove
clips.text: Salt hangs in the air. Somewhere beyond the fog, wood knocks quietly against a hidden jetty.

clips.label: Player chooses fighter
clips.text: A fighter knows that courage is a choice made before the first blow lands.

clips.label: Player chooses wizard
clips.text: A wizard understands that a question can be more dangerous than an answer.

clips.label: Player chooses rogue
clips.text: A rogue notices the door everyone else has decided not to see.

clips.label: Player chooses cleric
clips.text: A cleric carries conviction into places where certainty does not survive long.

clips.label: Before dice roll
clips.text: The outcome is not decided yet. When you are ready, roll.

clips.label: Skill check succeeds
clips.text: The attempt succeeds. Now we discover what your success changes.

clips.label: Skill check fails
clips.text: The attempt fails, but the story keeps moving. There may still be a choice worth making.

clips.label: Combat begins
clips.text: A threat steps forward. Before anyone moves, check where the danger stands.

clips.label: Turn begins
clips.text: Your turn. You can act, prepare, or choose another way through.

clips.label: Low health
clips.text: You have taken a hard hit. Decide whether to press on or protect yourself.

clips.label: Enemy defeated
clips.text: The danger has passed. For now, the room belongs to the survivors.

clips.label: Loot recovered
clips.text: There is something useful here. Take a closer look before deciding whether to carry it.

clips.label: Choice made
clips.text: You have chosen a path. Let us see what waits at its end.

clips.label: New chapter
clips.text: A new chapter begins. The world remembers what you have already done.

clips.label: Adventure ends in success
clips.text: Your adventure has reached its ending. Keep the choices that brought you here in mind.

clips.label: Adventure ends in failure
clips.text: This story has ended differently than you hoped. Its next telling can begin with a wiser choice.
